parameters.formDescription: Configure your transcript analysis run. All fields are optional - defaults will be used if not specified.

values.placeholder: Describe any specific styling preferences: dark theme, minimal design, corporate style, etc.
Sarah Chen, Mike Johnson, Jen Smith

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `List all transcript files in /transcripts/ and return a JSON array.

Supported formats:
- .vtt (WebVTT)
- .srt (SubRip)
- .txt (Plain text transcripts)
- .json (Structured transcripts)

For each file, return:
{
  "filename": "example.vtt",
  "format": "vtt",
  "sizeBytes": 12345,
  "modifiedTime": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
}

Output ONLY a JSON array, no other text:
[{"filename": "...", "format": "...", "sizeBytes": ..., "modifiedTime": "..."}]`, maxTurns: 5, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}

nodes.name: Analyze Files (Max 3 Parallel)
nodes.notes: Configure to point to 'VTT Single File Analyzer' subworkflow

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `You are creating a comprehensive synthesis of analyzed transcript files.

## Project Context
- Project Name: ${$json.config.projectName}
- Participants: ${$json.config.participants.join(', ') || 'Not specified'}
- Tags: ${$json.config.tags.join(', ') || 'Not specified'}
- Date Range: ${$json.config.dateRange || 'Not specified'}

## Processing Summary
- Files successfully processed: ${$json.results.successful.length}
- Files skipped (unchanged): ${$json.results.skipped.length}
- Files failed: ${$json.results.failed.length}

## CRITICAL: Hierarchical Processing Required
Due to potentially large number of files, use batch processing:

### Step 1: Count and Batch
1. List all .md files in /transcripts/summaries/
2. Divide into batches of 20 files each

### Step 2: Create Batch Summaries
For each batch, create: /transcripts/batch-summaries/batch-XX.md

### Step 3: Meta Synthesis
Create /transcripts/combined-analysis.md with:

### Executive Summary
- Total sessions analyzed
- Overall themes and focus areas
- 5-7 key takeaways

### Question Frequency Analysis
| Question/Topic | Times Asked | Sessions |

### Topic Heatmap Data
Binary coverage matrix:
| Topic | Session 1 | Session 2 | ... | Coverage % |

### Cross-Session Insights
- Common Themes
- Unique Contributions
- Knowledge Gaps

### Tools & Resources Compendium
| Resource | Type | Sessions | Context |

### Investigation Priorities
Things warranting further research

### Recommended Review Order
Suggested order for consuming content

### Master Q&A Index
All questions organized by topic

### Session Quick Reference
One-line summary per session

## Output
Write to /transcripts/combined-analysis.md
After completing, output: "SYNTHESIS COMPLETE"`, maxTurns: 30, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `Create an interactive HTML dashboard from the analysis.

## Project Branding
- Dashboard Title: ${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.dashboardTitle}
- Primary Color: ${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.primaryColor}
- Secondary Color: ${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.secondaryColor}
- Accent Color: ${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.accentColor}
- Logo URL: ${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.logoUrl || 'none'}

## Custom Styling Instructions
${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.stylingInstructions || 'Use a clean, professional design suitable for business use.'}

## Custom CSS to Include
${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.customCss || '/* No custom CSS */'}

## Sections to Include
${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.sections.join(', ')}

## Your Task
Read /transcripts/combined-analysis.md (and /transcripts/analysis-data.json if it exists) and create an engaging HTML dashboard.

## Design Requirements
- Apply the branding colors throughout
- If logo URL provided, display it in the header
- Include the custom CSS in a <style> block
- Follow the custom styling instructions
- Only include the sections specified above

## Technical Requirements
- Single self-contained HTML file
- All CSS/JS inline (except D3.js CDN for knowledge graph)
- Mobile responsive with media queries
- Dark/light mode toggle (localStorage)
- Print stylesheet
- Pagination for large lists (20 per page)
- Search/filter functionality
- Debounced search (300ms)

## Required Components (include if in sections list)
- Hero Section with stats and key takeaways
- Question Explorer with dynamic category filters
- Topic Heatmap (scrollable)
- Tools Gallery with auto-detected categories
- Session Navigator (paginated)
- Knowledge Graph (D3.js)
- Investigation Queue with localStorage
- Global Search

## Output
Write to /transcripts/dashboard.html
Output: "DASHBOARD_COMPLETE"`, maxTurns: 35, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `Add a D3.js knowledge graph to /transcripts/dashboard.html.

## Requirements
- Use D3.js v7 from CDN
- Show top 50 most-connected nodes by default
- Filter controls: slider for node count, checkboxes for Topics/Tools/Sessions
- Colors: topic=${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.primaryColor}, tool=${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.secondaryColor}, session=${$('Merge Configuration').first().json.config.accentColor}
- Draggable nodes, click to highlight, hover tooltips
- Zoom and pan support
- Respect dark mode toggle
- Performance: stop simulation at alpha < 0.001

Output: "KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_ADDED"`, maxTurns: 25, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}
